invalidAmount.title: Check the amount
invalidAmount.message: Enter an amount greater than zero.
invalidAmount.guidance: Use the currency shown on this screen. Amounts are never converted automatically.

invalidCredentials.title: Check your sign-in details
invalidCredentials.message: We could not verify your wallet signature or account identifier.
invalidCredentials.guidance: Reconnect your wallet, approve the new request, and try again. Wallet addresses are never translated.

invalidInput.title: Review the details
invalidInput.message: One or more values could not be accepted.
invalidInput.guidance: Check the highlighted fields and keep identifiers exactly as provided.

sessionExpired.title: Session needs attention
sessionExpired.message: Your secure session is no longer active.
sessionExpired.guidance: Sign in again to continue. Do not repeat a payment until you see its final status.

accessDenied.title: Access restricted
accessDenied.message: You do not have permission for this action.
accessDenied.guidance: Switch to an account with the required access or contact support with the reference below.

notFound.title: Not available
notFound.message: We could not find the requested item.
notFound.guidance: Refresh the list and check the identifier before trying again.

conflict.title: State changed
conflict.message: Something changed while your request was being processed.
conflict.guidance: Refresh to see the latest state, then retry only if the action is still needed.

duplicateRequest.title: Already submitted
duplicateRequest.guidance: Check the current status instead of submitting it again; repeating it will not change the result.

rateLimited.title: Please slow down
rateLimited.message: Too many requests were sent in a short time.
rateLimited.guidance: Wait for the suggested delay, then try again once.

unavailable.title: Temporarily unavailable
unavailable.message: A required service is not responding.
unavailable.guidance: Wait a moment and retry. No money has moved unless you see a confirmed transaction.

invalidLoan.title: Check the loan
invalidLoan.message: The loan identifier or reference is not valid.
invalidLoan.guidance: Copy the identifier exactly as shown in your loan details and try again.

loanState.title: Loan state changed
loanState.message: This action is not available for the current loan state.
loanState.guidance: Refresh the loan details. Already-repaid loans never need another payment.

insufficientFunds.title: Balance too low
insufficientFunds.message: The account does not have enough available balance.
insufficientFunds.guidance: Add funds or reduce the amount. The exact asset and units are shown in the form.

blockchain.title: Network issue
blockchain.message: The network did not confirm the operation.
blockchain.guidance: Check the transaction status before retrying. Do not submit the same signed transaction twice.

internal.title: Something went wrong
internal.message: We could not complete the request.
internal.guidance: Try again shortly. If it keeps happening, contact support with the reference below.

fallback.title: Unexpected error
fallback.guidance: Retry once, then contact support with the reference below if it persists.

Offers.title: Compare loan and pool offers
Offers.description: Sort columns with the keyboard or compare the card layout on small screens. Amounts keep their source currency.
Offers.caption: Loan and pool offer comparison. Column headers sort the table; each row name is a row header.
Offers.summary: Showing {visible} of {total} offers. Sorted by {column} {direction}. Filters: {filters}.
Offers.sortAction: Activate to sort by this column

states.error: Offers could not be loaded. Retry from the lender portal.
states.empty: No offers match the current filters.
states.invalid: That sort or filter action was invalid and was ignored.

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.description: Control how sensitive account data is displayed on this device.
Privacy.reducedDataModeDesc: Mask account identifiers and balances on sensitive screens. Hidden values are absent from copied text, screenshots, and accessible names.
Privacy.addressesMasked: Wallet addresses show as a mask instead of the real address
Privacy.balancesMasked: Balances and amounts show as a mask instead of the real value
Privacy.scoresMasked: Credit scores show as a mask instead of the real number
Privacy.copyDisabled: Copy buttons on masked values are disabled
Privacy.revealHint: Use the eye toggle on any masked value to temporarily reveal it
Privacy.localOnly: This preference is stored locally on this device only. It does not affect your account data on the blockchain or backend.
